title.zh: 宣布每年3月7日为巴西兰省特别非工作假日，以纪念该省建省周年，定名为“巴西兰日”，并确认“滕农帕卡拉贾安”为巴西兰省官方节日的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring March 7 of Every Year a Special Non-working Holiday in the Province of Basilan, in Commemoration of Its Foundation Anniversary to Be Known as “Araw Ng Basilan”, and in Recognition of the “Tennun Pakaradjaan” as the Official Festival of the Province of Basilan
title.orig: An Act Declaring March 7 of Every Year a Special Non-working Holiday in the Province of Basilan, in Commemoration of Its Foundation Anniversary to Be Known as “Araw Ng Basilan”, and in Recognition of the “Tennun Pakaradjaan” as the Official Festival of the Province of Basilan
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 7 tháng 3 hàng năm là ngày lễ không làm việc đặc biệt tại Tỉnh Basilan nhằm kỷ niệm ngày thành lập tỉnh và được gọi là “Ngày Basilan”, đồng thời công nhận lễ hội “Tennun Pakaradjaan” là lễ hội chính thức của Tỉnh Basilan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 7 เดือนมีนาคมของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดพิเศษไม่ทำงานในจังหวัดบาซิลันเพื่อรำลึกถึงวันครบรอบการก่อตั้งจังหวัดซึ่งเรียกว่า “อาโรงง์บาซิลัน” และเพื่อยกย่องเทศกาล “เทนนุนปาการาจาอัน” ให้เป็นเทศกาลอย่างเป็นทางการของจังหวัดบาซิลัน
title.id: Undang-Undang Menyatakan 7 Maret Setiap Tahun sebagai Hari Libur Khusus Tanpa Kerja di Provinsi Basilan dalam Memperingati Hari Ulang Tahun Pendiriannya yang Disebut sebagai “Araw Ng Basilan”, serta Mengakui “Tennun Pakaradjaan” sebagai Festival Resmi Provinsi Basilan
title.ms: Akta Mengisytiharkan 7 Mac Setiap Tahun sebagai Cuti Am Bertarikh Khas di Wilayah Basilan bagi Memperingati Hari Ulang Tahun Penubuhannya yang Dikenali sebagai “Araw Ng Basilan”, dan Mengiktiraf “Tennun Pakaradjaan” sebagai Festival Rasmi Wilayah Basilan

text.en: March 7 of every year is hereby directed a special non-working holiday in the Province of Basilan, in commemoration of its foundation anniversary, to be known as "Araw ng Basilan", and in recogntion of the "Tennun Pakaradjaan" as the official festival of the Province of Basilan.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
